description: Differential corpus for psychoscript (Code Mode's JavaScript-subset language): each case runs a program through upstream Runtime.make({ globals }).execute(program) (Tools/parity/psychoscript-oracle.ts) and the Swift CodemodeLanguage.makeRuntime port (Sources/OpenCodeParityRunner/PsychoscriptParity.swift) and compares the canonical outcome { ok, value | error: { kind, message, location?, suggestions? }, logs, warnings, truncated? }. args: [program, options?] where options = { timeoutMs?, maxOutputBytes?, translate? }. Names are prefixed with their category.

cases.name: arith: NaN and Infinity checks
args: return [NaN === NaN, Object.is(NaN, NaN), isNaN("x"), Number.isNaN("x"), 1/0, -1/0, String(0/0), String(1/0)]

cases.name: arith: negative zero
args: return [Object.is(-0, 0), Object.is(-0 * 1, -0), 1 / -0 === -Infinity, String(-0), (-0).toString(), JSON.stringify(-0), [-0].includes(0), [-0].indexOf(0), Math.sign(-0) === 0 && 1/Math.sign(-0)]

cases.name: arith: string to number coercion
args: return [Number(""), Number(" 42 "), Number("0x1f"), Number("0b101"), Number("0o17"), Number("1e3"), Number("12px"), +"  -3.5\n", Number(null), Number(undefined), Number(true), Number([]), Number([7]), Number([1,2]), Number({})].map(String)

cases.name: arith: parseInt / parseFloat
args: return [parseInt("08"), parseInt("0x10"), parseInt("10", 2), parseInt("z", 36), parseInt("  12abc"), parseInt(""), parseFloat("3.14more"), parseFloat(".5"), parseFloat("-.5e2"), parseInt("123", 0), parseInt("1", 37)].map(String)

cases.name: arith: toFixed / toPrecision / toExponential
args: return [(1.005).toFixed(2), (1.45).toFixed(1), (0).toFixed(2), (-1.5).toFixed(0), (123.456).toPrecision(4), (0.00001234).toPrecision(2), (1234.5678).toExponential(2), (255).toString(16), (255).toString(2), (-255).toString(36), (0.5).toString(2), (1e21).toFixed(2)]

cases.name: arith: loose equality table
args: return [null == undefined, null == 0, "" == 0, "0" == false, [] == false, [0] == false, [1] == 1, "1" == 1, NaN == NaN, ({}) == "[object Object]", null >= 0, undefined == 0]

cases.name: arith: Number statics
args: return [Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER, Number.EPSILON > 0, Number.isInteger(5.0), Number.isInteger(5.1), Number.isSafeInteger(2**53), Number.isFinite("5"), isFinite("5"), Number.parseFloat === parseFloat, Number.MAX_VALUE > 1e308, Number.MIN_VALUE]

cases.name: arith: typeof table
args: return [typeof 1, typeof "s", typeof true, typeof undefined, typeof null, typeof {}, typeof [], typeof (() => 1), typeof Symbol.iterator, typeof class {}, typeof Math, typeof undeclaredThing]

args: let a = 1; let b = a++ + ++a; let c = 10; c -= 3; c *= 2; c /= 7; c **= 3; let d = 5; d %= 3; d <<= 4; d ||= 9; let e = 0; e ||= 7; let f = 1; f &&= 8; let g = null; g ??= "x"; return [a, b, c, d, e, f, g]
